_comment: Membership rules for each page in the site nav.
mode 'org'      — models Arena attributes to this organization. Optional
`include` / `exclude` prefixes narrow it to one product
family, because the nav is organised by product and Arena
by company. Meta ships Llama *and* other lines; Google
ships Gemini *and* Gemma. Without a prefix filter the Llama
page fills up with models that are not Llama.
mode 'curated'  — an explicit list of arena_model_name values, for products
that run on other vendors' models. Nothing in Arena or
OpenRouter states which models a product uses, so this list
is editorial and goes stale on its own. Each needs a source
and a verified date; entries older than `stale_after_days`
Prefixes are matched against arena_model_name, case-insensitive.

llama.note: Arena's `meta` org covers more than Llama. Without the prefix filter this page fills with unrelated Meta models.

copilot.note: Availability varies by surface (M365 Copilot / Copilot Studio / Cowork), by region, and by admin policy — Anthropic models are off by default for EU/EFTA/UK tenants. Decide with the content team which surface the page describes before filling this in.

perplexity.note: Runs a mix of third-party models plus its own Sonar family. Sonar is not benchmarked on Arena, so it will have no score — decide whether the table shows only the third-party models or needs an extra column.
